answers.answer: The team initially considered using a buzzer or sensor system to locate a lost remote, which was later changed to a clap-activated finder system to ensure it was accessible to all age groups. Speaker C suggested marketing the product as a 'finder function' to distinguish it from standard voice recognition technologies.
